about.heading: A congress is more than a programme and a room
paragraphs: A good congress moves people forward. New insights, valuable conversations and connections that keep paying off long after.
At JCC we make sure everything is right. From programme and speakers to venue, registration and the smallest details. So you can focus on what really matters: the people and the content.
about.trustLabel: On the agenda for, among others

images.alt: The audience applauding in a full hall at SLAAP2025

annick.heading: Hi, I’m
paragraphs: Organising congresses is pretty much in my blood by now. For years I worked at the Amsterdam Congress Bureau, part of I amsterdam. Then I chose a very different view: as a KLM flight attendant, I flew all over the world.
But I never let go of congresses. Even between my intercontinental flights, I kept organising them. And there were more and more!
At some point it simply no longer fitted alongside my work in the air. Time to choose. Now I can focus entirely on JCC.
And that’s exactly what makes me happy: bringing people together, arranging everything down to the last detail and making sure a congress doesn’t just run smoothly, but really makes an impact.

community.heading: The congress ends.
community.lead: A congress brings people together. But why should that connection stop after one day? JCC helps associations and organisations keep the conversation going. With newsletters, meetings and new ways to share knowledge.
community.closing: That way, one congress becomes the start of something more.

band.intro: No two congresses are the same. Luckily.
band.text: A small symposium or a large international congress: every event needs its own approach. We think along, keep the lines short and make sure everything is well arranged. With care for both the content and the people.

social.title: Science by day,
social.text: The best conversations don’t always happen in the congress hall. That’s why we also organise the programme around it. From relaxed drinks to a party people talk about for a long time.
